answer: Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The prism panel is drawn blind, the beacon escrow settles at close, and thread lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 18% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 369 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
